tagline: Happy Horse AI is a multimodal video generation platform designed to transform text, images, and audio into cinematic content
description: Happy Horse AI is a multimodal video generation platform designed to transform text, images, and audio into cinematic content. By integrating a sophisticated input pipeline, the tool allows users to combine various media formats to produce high-quality videos with lifelike motion and realistic physics. The platform functions as an AI director, handling the complexities of visual storytelling, sound synchronization, and character consistency in a single generation process. Advanced Storyboarding
